CONSULTATION FAQS

Every inquiry is met with absolute discretion, prompt attention, and thoughtful consideration.

While psychotherapy primarily explores the past to heal psychological wounds and consulting provides pre-packaged business answers, transformational coaching is a forward-focused inquiry into your current values, somatic states, and future alignment. We honor your lived history while focusing on cultivating self-sovereignty, dismantling conditioned behavioral scripts, and designing actionable structures for your life and career.
